name: Diff Review
description: AI code review panel with file-level accept/reject, per-file unified diff view, and summary stats for additions and deletions.

props.name: files
props.description: Required. Changed files with path, additions, deletions, unified diff lines and a pending, accepted or rejected status. Example: files={[{ path: "a.ts", additions: 2, deletions: 1, lines: [], status: "pending" }]}

props.name: onAccept
props.description: Called with the file path when one diff is accepted. Example: onAccept={(path) => accept(path)}

props.name: onReject
props.description: Called with the file path when one diff is rejected. Example: onReject={(path) => reject(path)}

props.name: onAcceptAll
props.description: Called by the Accept all button. Example: onAcceptAll={acceptEverything}

props.name: onRejectAll
props.description: Called by the Reject all button. Example: onRejectAll={rejectEverything}

props.name: className
props.description: CSS class names for the review card. Example: className="max-w-2xl"
